name: dmc-py
reason: Captured the older global install snapshot of dmc-py before global skill installs were paused. This snapshot predates the dmc-best-practices extraction and contains the bundled rules/ directory plus three reference files (best-practices.md, best-practices-expanded.md, common-tasks-and-troubleshooting.md, core-patterns-and-components.md) that are now redundant with the dmc-best-practices skill. The repo's skills/dmc-py/ remains the active canonical version, with cross-references to the separate dmc-best-practices skill.
restore: To restore the bundled-rules shape, copy this directory back to ~/.agents/skills/dmc-py. The active repo source at skills/dmc-py/ does not need to change; it already points at dmc-best-practices for the rule set.
